meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Cirq 库构建、模拟和优化量子电路，并在 Google Quantum AI 或 IonQ 等硬件上运行，还支持噪声建模和参数扫描。
howto.when: 当你说要针对 Google Quantum AI 硬件、设计噪声感知电路或运行量子表征实验时。

say.text: 帮我用 Cirq 设计一个抗噪的量子电路。
say.note: Claude 会使用噪声建模来设计电路。

say.text: 用 Cirq 做随机基准测试来表征噪声。
say.note: Claude 会生成实验并分析结果。

say.text: 把这个 Cirq 电路提交到 Google 量子硬件上运行。
say.note: Claude 会配置硬件执行并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Cirq to build, simulate, and optimize quantum circuits, run them on Google Quantum AI or IonQ hardware, and handle noise modeling and parameter sweeps.
howto.when_en: When you say you want to target Google Quantum AI hardware, design noise-aware circuits, or run quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Help me design a noise-resistant quantum circuit with Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will use noise modeling to design the circuit.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to run randomized benchmarking to characterize noise.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the experiment and analyze results.

say_en.text: Submit this Cirq circuit to run on Google quantum hardware.
say_en.note: Claude will configure the hardware run and return results.
